principles: Explain each selection with film-specific evidence, not an unexplained quality score.
Awards and box-office success are distinct signals, neither sufficient alone.
Do not exclude commercial cinema, comedy, animation or popular genres categorically.
Keep original Odia work, dubbed versions, full films and trailers accurately distinguished.
No claim to have personally watched all films or to provide an objective best-film ranking.
Initial selection is limited by retained research and verified viewing routes; exclusion from features is not a negative assessment.
Omission reflects this focused collection, not a blanket genre classification or negative quality judgement.
